```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(fs)
library(glue)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(yaml)
source(here("case_studies", "src", "R", "visualize.R"))
source(here("case_studies", "src", "R", "error_rate_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
base <- path(here("case_studies", "sweep_tabular"))
cfg <- read_yaml(base / "config.yaml")

evaluation_dir <- base / "results" / "evaluation"
fig_dir <- base / cfg$figures_dir
dir_create(fig_dir)
theme_set(theme_axiomatic(base_size = 12))
```

```{r}
ev <- load_evaluation(evaluation_dir)
theoretical <- load_theoretical_table(
    base / "table1_theoretical.csv", cfg$theoretical_rows
)

save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 11, height = 7) {
    ggsave(fig_dir / name, plot, width = width, height = height)
    plot
}
```

- $H_0(j, \text{notion})$ means that feature $j$ is null under that notion;
- a **type I error** calls a null feature relevant;
- a **type II error** misses a relevant feature.

```{r confusion-conditional}
confusion_panel(ev$confusion, "conditional") |>
    save_fig("fig_confusion_conditional.svg", height = 8)
```

```{r confusion-causal}
confusion_panel(ev$confusion, "causal") |>
    save_fig("fig_confusion_causal.svg", height = 8)
```

## Error rates

```{r fpr}
error_rate_heatmap(ev$pooled, "fpr", midpoint = cfg$evaluation$alpha) |>
    save_fig("fig_type1_error.svg", height = 6)
```

```{r power}
error_rate_heatmap(ev$pooled, "power", midpoint = cfg$evaluation$power_target) |>
    save_fig("fig_power.svg", height = 6)
```

## Dependence on the threshold

```{r pr-curves}
pr_curve_panel(ev$sweep, "conditional") |>
    save_fig("fig_pr_conditional.svg", height = 6)
```

```{r roc}
roc_panel(ev$curves) |>
    save_fig("fig_roc_auc.svg", height = 6)
```

```{r table1}
table1_comparison_plot(ev$table1) |>
    save_fig("fig_table1_empirical.svg", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r table1-numbers}
ev$table1 |>
    select(
        method, notion, n_cells, controlled_fraction, powered_fraction,
        mean_fpr, mean_power, symbol, is_target_notion
    ) |>
    arrange(method, notion) |>
    knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
